title: arenaria favargeri
intro:
Arenaria favargeri, commonly known as Rock Jasmine, is a flowering plant species in the Caryophyllaceae family, known for its fragrant and delicate white flowers.

This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria favargeri include its ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
